name: orbit-hub
description: OrbitHub — universal app (Android, iOS, Web) to organise workspaces, tasks, lists and notes.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @orbit-hub/contracts && npm run build --workspace @orbit-hub/config
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run config:check
